shorts.title: Army Ants Can March in a Circle Until They All Die
shorts.hook: Army ants can get stuck walking in a circle until they die.
shorts.outro: Doug's other six deaths are in the full video below.
shorts.description: A century ago William Beebe measured an army ant death circle 1,200 feet around, and Doug fell in line; the rest of the swarm is in the full episode, Why Army Ants Only Kill What Can't Run Away, Like Doug.

shorts.title: In Army Ant Colonies, the Workers Choose the Queen
shorts.hook: Army ant workers pick their queen, and the losers get left behind.
shorts.outro: Six more Doug deaths, and one short walk, are in the full video below.
shorts.description: When an army ant colony splits, the workers decide which young queen leads and hold the others back, so Doug's audition goes badly; see the whole colony in the full episode, Why Army Ants Only Kill What Can't Run Away, Like Doug.

shorts.title: A Swarm of 20 Million Driver Ants Moves 20 Meters an Hour
shorts.hook: One African driver ant colony can hold twenty million workers.
shorts.outro: The seven times Doug didn't walk away are in the full video below.
shorts.description: Twenty million African driver ants crawl so slowly that researchers just move their chairs, and for once Doug walks away; watch the full episode, Why Army Ants Only Kill What Can't Run Away, Like Doug.
